aligned_read_bases.denominator: Count of aligned query bases in primary records.
aligned_read_bases.description: Primary mapped nucleotide bases represented by CIGAR M, =, or X. Excludes soft clips, insertions, and hard clips.
aligned_read_bases.label: Aligned primary-read bases

clipped_read_fraction.denominator: Soft-clipped primary reads / all mapped primary reads.
clipped_read_fraction.description: Fraction of primary mapped read alignments carrying one or more soft clips, counting each mapped primary record once.
clipped_read_fraction.label: Fraction of mapped reads clipped

deleted_reference_bases.denominator: Count of CIGAR D reference bases.
deleted_reference_bases.description: Reference-consuming deletions in primary alignments, from CIGAR D. A deletion is not automatically a sequencing or assembler error.
deleted_reference_bases.label: Mapped reference deletion bases

final_contig_31mer_redundancy_fraction.description: Proportion of assembled 31-mer instances repeated in other contigs. A heuristic indicator of redundancy, not misassembly.
final_contig_31mer_redundancy_fraction.label: Redundant contig 31-mer fraction

final_contig_count.description: Number of assembled contigs passed to downstream MiCall processing. Neither more nor fewer alone proves correctness.
final_contig_count.label: Final contig count

final_contig_total_bases.denominator: Sum of assembled contig sequence lengths.
final_contig_total_bases.description: Sum of lengths of all final assembled contigs. Overlapping and duplicate segments are counted repeatedly.
final_contig_total_bases.label: Total contig bases

inserted_bases.denominator: Count of CIGAR I query bases.
inserted_bases.description: Nucleotide insertions in primary read alignments, from CIGAR I. True biological indels cannot be classified as errors from this alone.
inserted_bases.label: Mapped primary-read insertion bases

mapq_zero.denominator: Count of mapped primary records with MAPQ 0.
mapq_zero.description: Mapped primary reads assigned MAPQ 0, which indicates no mapping confidence on the SAM scale.
mapq_zero.label: Primary reads with MAPQ 0

mean_known_mapq.denominator: Sum of known primary MAPQ / primary records with MAPQ != 255.
mean_known_mapq.description: Mean mapping quality among mapped primary alignment records with known MAPQ. SAM MAPQ 255 denotes unknown and is excluded.
mean_known_mapq.label: Mean known MAPQ

nuc_q15_covered_fraction.description: Fraction of expected positions with supported Q15 nucleotide coverage, as available in MiCall's nucleotide summary.
nuc_q15_covered_fraction.label: Q15 breadth

nuc_q15_mean_depth.denominator: Mean depth over represented Q15 nucleotide positions.
nuc_q15_mean_depth.description: Average nucleotide read depth among the positions represented in MiCall's quality-cutoff-15 nucleotide summary.
nuc_q15_mean_depth.label: Mean Q15 depth

nuc_soft_clips_count.denominator: Sum or deduplicated per-position nuc.csv clip aggregate.
nuc_soft_clips_count.description: MiCall's aggregated per-position nuc.csv clip count. This quantity has different inclusion and duplication rules than SAM soft clips.
nuc_soft_clips_count.label: MiCall per-position clip aggregate

primary_mapped.denominator: Count of primary mapped alignment records.
primary_mapped.description: Primary alignment records marked mapped in the SAM. Secondary and supplementary records are excluded; records need not be unique molecules.
primary_mapped.label: Primary mapped reads

primary_mapped_fraction.description: Fraction of primary SAM alignment records marked mapped; this is a read-record rate, not a genome reconstruction score.
primary_mapped_fraction.label: Primary mapped read fraction

primary_unmapped.denominator: Count of primary unmapped alignment records.
primary_unmapped.description: Primary alignment records carrying the SAM unmapped flag. Not the same as a count of unmatched original read pairs.
primary_unmapped.label: Primary unmapped reads

region_concordance_mean.denominator: Mean of valid region concordance percentages.
region_concordance_mean.description: Mean MiCall regional concordance between the final result and the aligned reference panel, evaluated only after assembly.
region_concordance_mean.label: Mean region concordance

secondary.denominator: Count of SAM secondary alignment records.
secondary.description: SAM secondary alignments, including alternative placements. A large count can reflect legitimate multi-mapping rather than errors.
secondary.label: Secondary alignments

soft_clip_events.denominator: Count; per 1,000 mapped primary reads is available separately.
soft_clip_events.description: CIGAR S operations on primary mapped reads. One read can contribute a left and right clip event.
soft_clip_events.label: Soft-clip events

soft_clip_events_per_1000_primary_mapped.description: Frequency of individual left/right CIGAR S clipping operations among mapped primary alignment records.
soft_clip_events_per_1000_primary_mapped.label: Clip events per 1,000 mapped reads

soft_clipped_bases.denominator: Count; normalized per 1,000 mapped sequenced bases separately.
soft_clipped_bases.description: Total nucleotide bases excluded by CIGAR S operations on primary mapped alignment records.
soft_clipped_bases.label: Soft-clipped bases

soft_clipped_bases_per_1000_read_bases.description: Total soft-clipped nucleotides normalized by mapped primary-read sequence bases. A shorter clipped fraction is not necessarily biologically more accurate.
soft_clipped_bases_per_1000_read_bases.label: Clipped bases per 1,000 mapped read bases

soft_clipped_reads.denominator: Count; mapped primary alignment records are the reference population.
soft_clipped_reads.description: Primary mapped alignment records with at least one CIGAR S operation. Both ends of the same read count once here.
soft_clipped_reads.label: Soft-clipped primary reads

supplementary.denominator: Count of SAM supplementary alignment records.
supplementary.description: SAM supplementary alignments, often associated with split mappings. Whether more or fewer is desirable depends on the sample.
supplementary.label: Supplementary alignments

note: One fully verified completed example only; not a 400-case cohort or seven-way qualification. Current image fork-commit provenance is not yet verified.
